title: Total Internal Reflection (TIR)
definition: TIR is an optical phenomenon occurring when a light ray traveling from a denser medium to a rarer medium strikes the interface at an angle greater than the 'critical angle', resulting in the light being completely reflected back into the denser medium.
importanceInUpsc: TIR is a high-frequency topic in UPSC Prelims (Science & Tech) due to its direct application in fiber optics, telecommunications, and natural phenomena like mirages.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Total Internal Reflection.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
